title: NagisinnraLinux 1.0.8
content: NagisinnraLinux is a Japanese Linux distribution based on Debian's "Stable" branch. Featuring a lightweight Xfce desktop, it is specifically designed to revive older hardware and provide a snappy and minimal, yet fully functional desktop environment for daily use. The distribution's main features include out-of-the-box support for the Japanese language, advanced memory optimisation, use of zram compression to guarantee smooth multitasking, and removal of unnecessary and redundant services to maximise battery life and CPU responsiveness.
